title: Accession leaves sourcePublishedAt/retrievedAt null so age-decay sourcePublishedAtDay cannot land
description:
## Expected
Accessioned references carry publication/retrieval timestamps when known so vector metadata can write sourcePublishedAtDay / retrievedAtDay.

## Observed
After accession, four new refs had sourcePublishedAt=null, retrievedAt=null. Sidecar had retrieved_at but GraphQL did not. Force sync wrote retrievedAtDay from importedAt. sourcePublishedAtDay absent until manual update_record set arXiv 2025-05-19 from PDF header.

## Impact
kanbus-4b0aa6 Rebuild A only partially activated without publication dates.
